summary: One-button endless rooftop runner in Godot 4 with a rhythm mode that lays obstacles on the music's beat grid and a post-run timing histogram. Turkish and English UI, playable in the browser.
key_features: One-button endless rooftop runner: the only input is when to press
Rhythm mode lays every obstacle on the music's beat grid instead of a random spacer
Post-run timing histogram shows how early or late each press landed
Daily run seeded from the date, so every player gets the same rooftops

Every bar pattern is bot-cleared at every song's beat spacing: obstacle geometry is in absolute pixels while the beat grid is 120 / 140.6 / 128.6 px, so an unclearable bar could have hidden in a rare pattern-song pair

social.headline: One button. Every obstacle on the beat.
